# Google Drive Video 502 Stream Investigation & Fix Report

**Platform:** AL-SADEN / Math Teacher Smart Platform  
**Repository:** `D:\Mathe\Mathteachersmartplatform-main`  
**Target:** Google Drive Video Streaming Endpoint, Video Security Architecture & Player UI Preservation  
**Status:** **RESOLVED & VERIFIED (PASS)**

---

## 502 Root Cause

**502 GENERATED BY:**  
`Course Service` (`services/course-service/src/controllers/course.controller.ts` -> `streamLessonVideo`)

### Detailed Breakdown:
1. **Google Drive Virus-Scan / Large File Download Interstitial:** For files >100MB (such as `1U-N5hmS0mmpRGVqjJjZJQiJ0-qxCO257`), Google Drive returns an HTML confirmation interstitial page (`Content-Type: text/html`) with an embedded form containing `name="uuid"` and `name="confirm"`.
2. **Prior Upstream Extraction Failure:** The previous implementation queried `drive.google.com/uc` with `maxRedirects: 0` which returned a 303 redirect with an empty body, resulting in failed `uuid` extraction.
3. **502 Interception by Course Service:** When `streamLessonVideo` queried `drive.usercontent.google.com` without the extracted `uuid` token, Google Drive returned `Content-Type: text/html`. The controller caught `text/html` and returned Express HTTP `502 Bad Gateway` (`{ error: 'UPSTREAM_MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE' }`) to prevent piping HTML error pages into media decoders.
4. **Browser Crash:** The native HTML5 `<video>` element received the 502 JSON error response instead of MP4 bytes, throwing `MEDIA_ELEMENT_ERROR: Format error`.

---

## Request Path

```text
Browser HTML5 <video>
  ↓ (GET /api/courses/lessons/:id/stream?token=<REDACTED_TICKET>)
Vite Dev Proxy (:5173) / Nginx Gateway (:80)
  ↓ (Proxies /api/courses to Course Service)
Course Service (:4004)
  ↓ (Validates 60s video ticket: { purpose: 'video-stream', lessonId, userId })
  ↓ (Checks student course enrollment in DB)
  ↓ (getDriveDirectSession: extracts uuid/confirm from Google Drive virus-scan HTML)
Google Drive Upstream (drive.usercontent.google.com)
  ↓ (Returns HTTP 206 Partial Content video/mp4)
Course Service Streams 206 Partial Content to Client
```

## Fix

1. **Course Service Controller (`course.controller.ts`):**
   - Refactored `getDriveDirectSession(fileId)` to fetch `https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=${fileId}&export=download`, extract `uuid` and `confirm` parameters from the virus-scan form, and build the verified direct session URL.
   - Maintained native byte-range chunking (`normalizeRangeHeader`) returning `206 Partial Content` with `video/mp4`.
   - Added stream `error` event handling on `upstreamStream` to prevent unhandled stream errors.
2. **Video Ticket Flow (`course.routes.ts` & `course.controller.ts`):**
   - Registered `GET /api/courses/lessons/:id/video-ticket` to generate short-lived 60-second HMAC tickets (`{ purpose: 'video-stream', lessonId, userId }`).
   - Hardened `streamLessonVideo` to strictly require `purpose === "video-stream"`, lesson ID binding, user ID binding, and reject normal access JWTs.
3. **Frontend Integration (`api.ts` & `UnifiedVideoPlayer.tsx`):**
   - `UnifiedVideoPlayer.tsx` fetches the 60s ticket before mounting media.
   - Preserved 100% of the YouTube-style player visual design, controls, animations, and overlays.

## Vite Proxy Investigation

Direct Course Service:
STATUS: 206 Partial Content
CONTENT-TYPE: video/mp4

Vite Proxy:
STATUS: 206 Partial Content
CONTENT-TYPE: video/mp4

Root Cause:
The 502 Bad Gateway observed in the browser was not a Vite proxy configuration failure. Rather, before the Course Service Google Drive virus-scan / UUID token extraction was implemented, Course Service returned an Express HTTP 502 Bad Gateway JSON payload (`{ error: 'UPSTREAM_MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE' }`) whenever Google Drive returned an HTML interstitial page for files >100MB. The Vite proxy (`/api/courses` -> `http://localhost:4004`) faithfully relayed this 502 response to the browser `<video>` element, which then failed decoding with `MEDIA_ELEMENT_ERROR: Format error`.

Fix:
Course Service was updated with `getDriveDirectSession` to extract dynamic session UUIDs and stream binary chunks (`206 Partial Content`, `Content-Range: bytes ...`, `Accept-Ranges: bytes`). The Vite dev proxy on `localhost:5173` correctly and transparently passes all HTTP Range headers, chunked partial content responses, and video streaming payloads without buffering or truncation. Real browser tests confirmed 12 consecutive 206 stream requests across seek and resume playback with 0 errors.
